product: Vertically integrated lithium group: lithium hydroxide, carbonate, chloride, fluoride and lithium metal, plus batteries, energy-storage systems and battery recycling, spanning mining, refining and cell making.
demand: H1 2026 revenue rose about 177% YoY to RMB22.88bn on higher lithium salt prices and robust energy storage demand; Ganfeng LiEnergy reported over 30 GWh of pipeline won at SNEC in June 2026.
pricing_power: Limited. Ganfeng is largely a price taker on lithium carbonate and hydroxide and toned down its own price guidance in September 2026; the durable lever is captive low-cost feedstock rather than pricing.
competition: Main rivals are Tianqi Lithium, Albemarle, SQM, Pilbara Minerals and Yahua in lithium chemicals, and CATL and EVE Energy in batteries and energy storage; the H share fell 41% in three months as lithium prices weakened.
team: Chairman Liang Bin Li has led the board since 2007, Xiao Shen Wang is president and a director, and Ting Huang has been finance director and CFO since March 2023. Around 19257 employees.
market_strategy: Develop low-cost resources worldwide, chiefly Australia, Mali, Argentina and Cote d Ivoire, to lift self-supply toward 85%+, funded by green notes, and use the Lithium Argentina joint venture and convertible debenture to consolidate Salta projects; battery and storage expansion is the downstream leg.
bull: H1 2026 revenue RMB22.88bn up 177% YoY and net profit RMB4.43bn versus a year-earlier loss, driven by 42% gross margin lithium chemicals; self-supply near 70% rising above 85% cuts unit cost; Lithium Argentina JV and debenture consolidate Salta.
bear: UBS cut its target to HK$44.28 from HK$106.86 on 2026-09-23 and lowered 2027 China lithium price to CNY120000/t from CNY200000; management trimmed its own price guidance; H shares fell 41% in three months despite record H1 profit.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-11-03 showing lithium chemical segment gross margin below 42% or a net loss, proving the H1 profit swing was a price spike already reversing.
web_what_changed: H1 2026 results on 2026-08-28: revenue RMB22.88bn up about 177% YoY and net profit RMB4.43bn versus a year-earlier loss. Positive profit alert 2026-07-14. USD180m Lithium Argentina convertible debenture and Pozuelos-Pastos Grandes JV 2026-08-24. Non-prosecution decision from the People Procuratorate 2026-07-10. H shares closed HK$31.08 on 2026-09-25, down about 23% in a month and 41% in three months.
web_not_known_yesterday: UBS cut its Ganfeng target to HK$44.28 from HK$106.86 while keeping Buy and lowered its 2027 China lithium price assumption to CNY120000 per tonne from CNY200000, reported 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24. No company announcement dated 2026-09-25 was found; the latest HKEX filing read is dated 2026-09-18.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Mostly price and mix. Lithium compounds and metal were 61.6% of H1 2026 revenue at a 42% gross margin and batteries 34% at 11.9%, so the swing to profit came mainly from higher lithium salt prices. Battery and energy-storage volume added demand, with Ganfeng LiEnergy citing over 30 GWh of project pipeline on 2026-06-18.
web_suppliers: Feedstock comes largely from its own mines: Goulamina in Mali (233800 mt of concentrate in H1 2026), Mount Marion in Australia, Cauchari-Olaroz in Argentina (19000 mt LCE in H1) and Bambali in Cote d Ivoire; tantalum procurement framework with Ximei Resources 2026-08-19. Constraint: Mount Marion upgrade completes before 2028 and self-supply is targeted near 70% in 2026 rising above 85%.
web_customers: Customer concentration is not disclosed in the sources read; an aggregator summary of the FY2025 annual report says the top five customers were 15.5% of revenue, unverified from primary. China was 96.3% of H1 2026 revenue. Named battery and storage deals include LVTOPSUN 5 GWh on 2026-06-12, Dawnice 2 GWh, and a PISEN and EVE alliance on 2026-06-24.
web_who_loses: Higher-cost lithium producers and converters without captive feedstock lose price and share as Ganfeng adds low-cost volume: peers such as Tianqi Lithium, Albemarle, SQM, Pilbara Minerals and Yahua. Battery and storage buyers lose a cheap-lithium tailwind if prices recover. Host jurisdictions without incentive packages lose projects to Argentina RIGI-backed ones.
web_contradicting_evidence: Lithium carbonate prices weakened even in the September peak season, and UBS cut its 2027 China lithium price assumption to CNY120000 per tonne, down 40%. Management itself trimmed lithium carbonate price guidance citing 2027 supply growth of 20 to 25 percent, and UOB Kay Hian cut 2027-28 EPS on 2026-09-01. The H share fell 41.08% in three months to HK$31.08 despite the record H1 profit.
web_if_management_right: Self-supply near 70% in 2026 moving toward 85%+ lowers unit cost, and volume from Cauchari-Olaroz Phase II at 45000 t LCE plus Mount Marion and Goulamina expansions converts into margin. MarketScreener consensus showed 2026 revenue about RMB48bn with net income about RMB7.6bn and 2027 revenue near RMB56bn, so earnings keep compounding while the balance sheet degears.
web_if_management_wrong: If 2027 supply grows 20 to 25 percent and prices stall, ASP and inventory write-downs hit the 42%-margin chemical segment first and reverse the H1 swing. Then funding: net debt of about RMB24.5bn sits against roughly USD3bn of Argentina Salta and Mali capex, with RMB500m of green notes issued 2026-07-22 and RMB500m redeemed 2026-07-29.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Lithium Argentina AG, which closed USD180m from Ganfeng on 2026-09-15 and folded three Salta projects into a joint venture. Host governments in Argentina, Mali and Cote d Ivoire through taxes and the RIGI programme. Ximei Resources for tantalum. Equipment and EPC suppliers, plus battery and energy-storage integrators buying cheaper lithium.
